hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: Per-pool configurable Uniswap v4 launch hook. Pool creators set rules at initialization (trading start, allowlist, anti-snipe, wallet cap, same-block guard, buy burn, LP rewards, treasury fee, sell tax, exit decay, volatility fee, sandwich guard). Applies a 0.10% platform fee per swap. Reverts exact-output swaps when burn, reward, or treasury deductions apply.
